Cursor11 V2.0.0

Based on the Windows 11 Concept Light cursor set.

Cursor11 V2.0.0 design:
- Enlarged, narrow isosceles rounded triangles for directional cursors.
- Approximately 8 px paired-triangle gap at the 96 px design size.
- Move cursor is continuously filled at the center.
- Beam B uses 15 px standard caps with a stem shortened by 6%.
- Precision cursor uses a rounded crosshair.
- Light theme uses white glyphs with a black outline.
- Remaining cursors and animations retain their existing silhouettes.

Includes all 17 roles: pointer, help, working, busy, precision, beam,
handwriting, unavailable, vert, horz, dgn1, dgn2, move, alternate,
link, person, and pin.

Installation:
Open the extracted folder and double-click Install Cursor11.exe.
The installer offers Install Cursor11 and Restore Defaults.

Manual installation:
1. Right-click Install.inf and select Install.
2. Open Settings > Accessibility > Mouse pointer and touch.
3. Select Cursor11 V2.0.0.

Original concept design: Jepri Creations
https://www.deviantart.com/jepricreations

This is the Cursor11 V2.0.0 release build.
